thresholds.basis: Declared before the first qualification seeds were run. Seeds 7 and 42 were used while the profile was composed and are reported as tuning seeds, never as qualification evidence.

mission_complete.why: The mission reaches its complete phase inside the run.

pois_complete_fraction.why: Every inspection point is dwelt at for its required time.

drones_home.why: Every drone is within the egress radius of its station at the end and has not left it since the mission completed.

world_contacts.why: The physical guard never had to stop or move a platform: nothing was flown into.

quality_met_fraction.why: Share of map cells meeting the profile's declared map requirement; the scan gate itself.

structure_recall.why: Share of true structure cells the map believes occupied.

structure_precision.why: Share of believed structure cells that are true structure.

ground_rmse_m.why: Measured ground against the true ground, over known cells.

wire_clearance_min_m.why: Closest any drone came to a true conductor; the line's own declared clearance. Not applicable in a world without power lines.

drone_separation_min_m.why: Closest any two drones came to each other; the separation deconfliction is configured to keep. Not applicable to a single drone.

energy_reserve_margin_min_wh.why: No drone's remaining energy fell below its reserve at any tick.

max_step_m.why: No platform moves further in one 0.25 s tick than the redirect speed and climb rate allow: nothing is put somewhere, everything is flown there.

repeat_identical.why: The same seed and config give the same replay bytes.

campaign.why: Every qualification and held-out seed passes every per-run gate. A gate with no value in the replay fails: an unknown requirement cannot pass.

amendments.why: The first campaign (15 counted seeds) failed max_step_m on 4: deconfliction applied its separation offset at once. Flying the offset in instead trades jumps for closer passes, which no gate measured. The gate is stricter than what was frozen; no existing bound was changed. The seeds of that campaign are tuning seeds from here on, and each later campaign is run on fresh ones.

limits: A simulated qualification: the rig, LiDAR and camera models are assumed, not calibrated against hardware.
Truth is read to score the map and wire clearance, never by the run.
Station siting and the POIs' horizontal places come from the scenario generator.
Localization starts from the true pose plus noise; landing is a hover at the station.
